title: AP GOVERNOR REACHES TIRUMALA
article_text:
byTTD News•Featured,Featured Posts,Top Stories,VIP News

Tirumala, 17 September 2026: The Hon’ble Governor of Andhra Pradesh, Sri Abdul Nazeer, reached the Sri Baggy Rest House at Tirumala on Thursday. He was welcomed by the TTD Chairman Sri  B.R.Naidu, TTD EO Sri M. Ravichandra and CVSO Sri Muralikrishna with a floral bouquet.

TTD Board Member Sri Naresh, Reception Officials, Sri Bhaskar Sri Sathre Naik and other officials were present.

ISSUED BY THE TTD CHIEF PUBLIC RELATIONS OFFICER
